title: Trigger subsystem config (written by display forms; defaults apply to missing keys)

task_book.description: path of the task book, relative to the main session cwd or absolute

rotate_mb.description: append-only operational files (state/spawn.log, state/<job>/runs.jsonl, logs/events.jsonl) are renamed to <name>.1 when they would pass this size; the run ledger and launches never rotate

template.default: Make sure you are actively pushing the work forward and not idle. Re-read the task book {task_book} and confirm the current work has not drifted from it. Record run starts/ends, plans and campaigns with the {ledger_tool} tool. Relay this check to the child sessions you manage; each re-reads its own task book, not this one: {children}.

Pack up the experiments run since the last packup according to the project conventions and make sure the run ledger is complete. Relay to the child sessions you manage; each packs up its own experiments per its own task book: {children}.

slow_interval_s.description: timer-driven log analysis even when idle
